title: Protocol for performing pooled CRISPR-Cas9 loss-of-function screens
protocol: Plate 7.5 × 10^6 HEK293T cells into a 150 mm culture plate in 30 mL DMEM + 10% FBS for ∼50% confluence.
Transfect HEK293T cells with Mirus LT1 transfection reagent, 8 μg lentiviral packaging vector mix, and 8 μg library lentiviral plasmid at a 3:1 Mirus:DNA ratio.
Incubate cells for 72 h.
Collect viral supernatant through a 0.45 μm filter.
Use immediately or store at 4°C for up to one week or −80°C for up to six months.
Estimate viral titer by serial dilution before infection.
Infect cells with the volume of virus that results in a 20%–50% mCherry positive population 72 h after infection.
Plate 10 × 10^6 HuH7 cells into a 245 mm culture plate in DMEM + 10% FBS to achieve ∼80% confluence after 24 h.
Introduce sgRNA-containing viral medium to the cells with 8 μg/mL polybrene.
Incubate for 24 h.
Remove all media and replace with DMEM + 10% FBS.
Trypsinize and re-seed all cells into new plates at ∼40%–50% confluence.
Expand for another 24 h.
Begin antibiotic selection by replacing media with DMEM + 10% FBS containing 2 μg/mL puromycin.
Replace the selection media every 3-4 days until all control cells have died.
Once all the control cells have died, replace media with fresh DMEM + 10% FBS without antibiotic to allow for recovery.
Freeze cells at -80°C and store in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw cells in excess to prevent loss of coverage if cells die during thawing.
Passage cells after 48 hours and grow for another 48 hours (96 hours total).
Trypsinize adherent cells in excess of 1000× coverage in FACS sorting media.
Sort cells using a fluorescence-activated cell sorter and collect high and low fluorescence bins.
Spin cells at 500 × g for 10 min after sorting.
Aspirate FACS buffer carefully and wash cells once with PBS.
Spin cells again at 500 × g, remove PBS, and store cell pellets at -80°C.
Trpysinize and collect cells in media containing 10% FBS.
Count cells and seed in 245 mm square TC-treated culture dishes at 10% confluence (8–15 × 10^6 cells).
Seed the total amount of cells above 1000× coverage for each plate with cell culture media containing the drug or vehicle at the desired concentration.
Replace the media and drug/vehicle every 3 days until cells are confluent.
Repeat trypsinization, counting, seeding, and media replacement steps until vehicle control treated cells divide >10 times (doubling cycles).
When cells reach >10 doubling cycles, harvest cells by trypsinization and wash once in media containing 10% FBS.
Wash harvested cells once with PBS.
Spin cells at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate PBS from the spun cells.
Store cell pellet at -80°C.
Extract gDNA from frozen cell pellets using Qiagen QIAamp DNA Blood Midi Kit.
Load PCR products onto a 2% TBE-agarose gel.
Run the gel at 120 V for 50 minutes.
Excise the brightest band from the gel.
Purify the DNA product using QiaQuick Gel Extraction Kit according to modified manufacturer's instructions.
When dissolving the gel, add 4 volumes of Buffer QG instead of 3.
For the DNA precipitation step, add 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 at a 1:100 ratio.
For the wash step, wash with Buffer PE two times instead of once.
Elute DNA in Buffer EB.
Check DNA concentration using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay.
Verify DNA quality using a fragment analyzer.
Pool equal amounts of DNA from each screen sample to achieve a final concentration of 3 nM.
Send the pooled library for deep sequencing.
Send 50 μL of pooled library at 3 nM.
Send 30 μL of Bassik custom sequencing Illumina sequencing primer at 100 μM.
Request a 22–25 cycles single-end read sequencing.
Alternatively, request the sequencing facility to add 20%–30% PhiX.
Ensure a minimum of 200× coverage when choosing a sequencing platform.
Calculate required reads based on library size and PhiX addition.
For example, calculate reads for 30,000 elements, two cell samples, and 20% PhiX.
Request sequencing data in the demultiplexed FASTQ format.
Download raw sequencing FASTQ files.
Back up the downloaded FASTQ files.
Unzip the FASTQ files for analysis if necessary.
Use FASTQC for quality control assessment of FASTQ files.
Install casTLE version 1.0 and required modules on Linux or MacOS.
Install parallel python module to increase speed of casTLE analysis (optional).
Navigate to the folder containing casTLE scripts in Terminal.
Run casTLE scripts from the command line.
Run casTLE scripts from the top folder.
Create a bowtie index using makeIndices.py if not using the Bassik Human or Mouse CRISPR Knockout Library.
Align FASTQ sequences to the reference sgRNA library using makeCounts.py.
Include -r [number] in the command to change sequencing read length, default is 17 base pairs.
Indicate naming scheme for control sgRNAs with -n [prefix of negative control sgRNAs] if not using Bassik human or mouse library.
Estimate p-values for the combined casTLE results using the casTLE script addCombo.py.
Calculate false discovery rate (FDR) as described in step 32.
Compare casTLE effects and casTLE scores between replicates using the casTLE script plotRep.py.
Visualize distribution of sgRNAs for genes of interest versus null distribution using the casTLE script plotGenes.py.
